svg.title: An incident ends at the retro
svg.desc: A hand-drawn incident loop. Detect, triage, respond, recover, retro run down the page; a minor issue branches off to the backlog while major work continues down the main path, and a long edge carries prevention items from the retro back to detection. Side notes hold the working rules for each step.
svg.text: An Incident Ends at the Retro
Don't stop at recovery — the cause has to land in the backlog.
log it even if not now
